# Kition: the open pro suite for AI.

Kition is 16 professional editors, called kits, for office, design, media and engineering work, and each kit's one engine serves a person in its editor, an AI agent through its commands, and a program through code. Use the kits in Kition Desktop, put them in your own product with the Kition SDK, or give them to your agent with the `kition` command line.

## Where to start

- **Use it:** [kition.ai](https://kition.ai)
- **Build with it:** [developer.kition.ai](https://developer.kition.ai)
- **Give it to your agent:** `npx @kition/cli` ([the `kition` command line](https://github.com/KitionAI/kition-sdk/blob/main/docs/sdk/cli.md))
